why: sampled while the engine was still appending to it, so the file is many snapshots rather than the single compacted line a finished attempt leaves. Two steps are in flight and one has not started, which is the only place the difference between a sibling not yet started and a step downstream of a halt can be seen. Read cold its recording process is gone, so it reads as a crash unless a reader supplies a live process — which is the point: liveness is a property of now, never of the file
